errors.text_span: 图中可见范围约从 −1.8 到 1.6
errors.evidence: The description states the visible y-range of the data is approximately from -1.8 to 1.6. However, the lowest point on the graph, near the end of the x-axis, has a value of approximately -1.9, which is outside the stated lower bound of -1.8.

The description states that the line's final value is approximately -1.7 to -1.75. However, the graph shows that this final point is the minimum value on the entire plot, visibly lower than the first trough (which is at y≈-1.75). The final value is closer to -1.9.
